provenance.review: Mechanism and scope inspected against both original entries; conceptual hypothesis only.

sourceMilestones.description: The precise neuroplasticity mechanism that can be pharmacologically reversed, restoring opioid potency.
A targeted therapy that permanently resets addiction-related brain circuits without causing anhedonia or requiring lifelong medication.

edges.confidenceMeaning: Qualitative editorial confidence in conceptual fit only; not a measured probability or scientific validation.
edges.rationale: A qualified assay could supply measurements for a prospective transition-risk study.
edges.uncertainty: Current-state diagnosis does not establish future prediction, effective prevention or the stated success rate.

provenance.origin: New remaining-collection review; interpreted directly from original milestone descriptions, not the legacy prerequisites.
provenance.review: Mechanism and scope inspected against both original entries; conceptual hypothesis only.

sourceMilestones.description: A reliable blood test, EEG, fMRI signature, or multi-omic panel that provides definitive, biologically grounded diagnosis and subtyping with >95% accuracy.
A validated, scalable screening + intervention protocol that identifies individuals at imminent risk of psychosis and prevents transition with >80% success.

CAR-02.reason: No specific intervention connecting the multiple diastolic, vascular and inflammatory components is supplied. A generic aging or inflammation target is not an HFpEF cure mechanism.

CAR-03.reason: No qualified molecular intervention for fibrosis, triggers and re-entry is specified; neural coding and ablative brain tools are not this non-ablative atrial therapy.

CAR-06.reason: No tissue-selective mineral-removal mechanism is identified. General growth or molecular targeting does not establish restoration of a calcified valve.

CAR-07.reason: No defined vascular-remodeling intervention addresses the listed heterogeneous PAH mechanisms and ventricular failure.

CAR-08.reason: No arrhythmia-specific predictive marker plus stabilizing intervention is provided. Atrial-fibrillation control is not prevention of all sudden cardiac death.

INF-01.reason: The conserved antiviral target overlaps VIR-02. Preserve both source goals without a target-to-target causal arrow.

INF-02.reason: The latency/reservoir ambition overlaps VIR-03; no independent intervening mechanism is specified.

INF-03.reason: The spillover/adaptation model overlaps VIR-04; one full model is not another full model’s prerequisite.

INF-05.reason: Bacterial persister tolerance is not identical to latent clinical TB. No qualified organism-specific, single-dose eradication route is supplied.

INF-06.reason: The antigen principle in IMM-02 is explicitly viral; it does not provide a parasite-specific all-stage malaria vaccine mechanism.

INF-10.reason: The unknown-infectious-agent goal overlaps VIR-10; an unknown entity cannot be assigned a useful target or transmission intervention in advance.

END-02.reason: No particular set-point circuit, molecular target or hunger-preserving intervention is supplied; generic neural coding does not resolve weight regulation.

END-03.reason: No qualified follicle-reserve, activation and safety mechanism is supplied. General stem-cell rejuvenation is not assumed to replenish ovarian follicles.

END-05.reason: No specific reversible puberty-clock intervention is identified; a general regulatory grammar does not establish a safe endocrine control.

END-07.reason: The PCOS root-cause goal overlaps OBG-07. No distinct cause or intervention makes the complete goals a causal sequence.

END-08.reason: No qualified insulin-sensitivity mechanism across the named tissues is supplied. Regenerating beta cells does not establish reversal of insulin resistance.

NEP-05.reason: No particular early progression marker set or validated risk model is supplied; a lifespan clock or generic multi-omics framework is not a kidney-failure predictor.

NEP-08.reason: No prevention mechanism covers all the listed ICU, surgical, contrast and infection contexts. A sepsis treatment is not universal AKI prophylaxis.

NEP-09.reason: The renal hypertension mechanism is unspecified; a shared blood-pressure outcome does not make it the cause of pregnancy hypertension.

NRL-04.reason: The original source flags equivalence to BME-02; preserve the reference without a causal alias arrow.

NRL-06.reason: No qualified acute ischemic neuroprotection agent is identified. A hypothetical suspended-animation state is not an established stroke treatment.

NRL-09.reason: The source goal overlaps PED-01 while extending age and symptom scope. No single defect, cure or independent causal link is established.

OBG-01.reason: No pregnancy-specific hypertension mechanism or maternal/fetal-safe intervention is supplied; essential renal hypertension is a different target.

OBG-02.reason: The entry names an all-etiology outcome without a specified labor-control mechanism; generic prediction does not prevent preterm birth.

OBG-04.reason: A long-read assembler does not establish fetal signal separation from maternal blood or early low-signal genetic testing; no qualified non-invasive assay is identified.

OBG-05.reason: The original source flags equivalence to END-03; preserve the ovarian-restoration duplicate metadata.

OBG-07.reason: The PCOS goal overlaps END-07; no new molecular mechanism justifies a goal-to-goal arrow.

OBG-08.reason: No safe, immediate, reversible sperm-specific intervention is supplied. Reproductive genetic incompatibility is not a qualified reversible contraceptive.

ONC-07.reason: No tumor-specific cachexia intervention is identified; general weight-set-point or growth control does not establish reversal without stimulating cancer.

ONC-09.reason: No conserved selective immortality circuit is supplied. General cell division or regulatory knowledge does not establish safe universal shutdown.

PED-01.reason: The autism mechanism/intervention ambition overlaps NRL-09. No uniform defect or normalization therapy is assumed.

PED-02.reason: Adult neural repair is not automatically neonatal repair; no developmental-stage-qualified intervention supplies full neonatal reconnection after hypoxia.

PED-03.reason: No qualified pediatric tumor/leukemia mechanism supplies one-course, all-cell eradication without late effects; adult targeting ambitions do not establish it.

PED-04.reason: The proposed infant-death trigger is unidentified; airway rescue and anesthesia-state mechanisms are not a universal SIDS cause or prevention.

PED-05.reason: The original source flags equivalence to END-01; preserve pediatric identity and its canonical source reference without a causal alias arrow.

PED-06.reason: No birth biomarker and validated neuroprotective intervention are supplied. A generic scanner does not establish prediction or prevention of cerebral palsy.

PED-09.reason: No qualified fetal-safe access and morphogenesis-correction mechanism is supplied. In-vivo printing does not establish a non-invasive in-utero platform.

PSY-02.reason: No particular causal pathway or therapeutic target for the multiple symptom domains is identified; a general brain theory is not a cure.

PSY-03.reason: No rapid and durable antidepressant mechanism is supplied. Plasticity or regeneration in general does not establish depression remission.

PSY-04.reason: The prevention goal overlaps EMR-08’s trauma-memory intervention; two complete PTSD-prevention goals are not a causal chain.

PSY-07.reason: No qualified enhancer or therapy-specific learning intervention is identified; a memory model does not itself provide an effective compound or device.

PSY-08.reason: Weight regulation is not the same mechanism as body-image distortion or compulsive behavior. No qualified eating-disorder intervention is identified.

PSY-10.reason: Perceptual feature binding is not integrated identity or the mechanism of dissociation; no qualified circuit intervention is supplied.

rejectedCandidates.reason: The source antigen principle is viral, while malaria is a different infectious target; no universal cross-class vaccine mechanism is provided.
Beta-cell replacement is not reversal of tissue insulin resistance.
Long-read genome assembly is not fetal/maternal signal separation in an early maternal-blood assay.
Genetic reproductive incompatibility does not supply a safe reversible contraceptive.
A defended body-weight set point is not the full mechanism of an eating disorder.
Visual/perceptual binding is not an identity-integration treatment mechanism.
